status: Analytic necessary-condition audit, frozen after the disclosed n64 cutoff-7 pilot
field_constraint: A periodic H1 velocity whose exact native cube averages equal the archived numerical values, interpreted as nominal finite-volume means
test_field: a=P_K(w-u), computed solely as archived numerical values minus independently integrated exact MMS native means
hminus_upper: sum_inside_nonzero |a_hat_k|^2/|k|^2 plus all outside L2 mass divided by (cutoff+1)^2
gradient_lower: mean(|a-mean(a)|^2) divided by the upper H-1 norm
limits: No particular velocity reconstruction is assumed; the lower bound is conditional on exact native-mean conservation and periodic H1 regularity.
Curl inherits the same absolute L2 lower bound only for divergence-free reconstructions and the divergence-free reference.
Original solver cell-centered values are interpreted as nominal means, not claimed to carry an upstream exact-average guarantee.
Analytic formulas use floating point without interval-certified rounding; no original gate is upgraded.
The cutoff-7 n64 pilot was observed before this protocol; these are not blind prospective thresholds.
No new solver threshold, upstream defect, nonconvergence theorem for the solver, physical singularity or viscosity inference follows.
